title: Power Supply to Several Areas to Remain Affected on September 20 - Kashmir Life
full_text:
SRINAGAR: Power supply to Shuhama, Bakura, Khalmulla and adjoining areas will remain affected for six hours on September 20 due to a scheduled shutdown of the 33 kV Alasteng Tapline.
Chief Engineer, Distribution, Kashmir Power Distribution Corporation Limited (KPDCL), said the shutdown will be observed from 8 am to 2 pm on Sunday.
The affected areas include Shuhama, Bakura, Khalmulla and adjoining areas.
